dct_description_sm: This project targeted four First Nations communities in Quebec and those communities were involved in realising studies on vulnerability and created climate change adaptation plans.  This phase of the project build upon the project 'Appui aux communauts des Premires Nations du Qubec dans l'valuation des risques lis aux changements climatiques et planification de l'adaptation'. The purpose of the project was to: (1) determine risks and vulnerabilities to climate change; (2) create a strategy for adaptation to take into account traditional knowledge and science; (3) to quantify the community's awareness on the importance of climate change and to raise awareness Quebec's population to the realities of aboriginals and climate change; and (4) to enlarge adaptation plans so that they can be applied to other aboriginal communities.
